invariants.rationale: className is used as a key to look up class information, so it should not be null.
classProperties is populated during this method and passed to multiple functions, so it should not be null.
classElement is used to extract properties by name, so it should be non-null for property extraction.
An empty className would likely cause a failure in lookups and is probably invalid input.
MapProperties should always have a non-negative size; this is always true.
